snippet.title: Olympus Rangers - Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Welcome to the ultimate battle simulator, where you can build your team, manage your strategy, and take on dozens of opponents across a variety of battle modes. Do you have what it takes to become the champion? Climb the ranks in online play, challenge Olympus, and prove you have what it takes to be the very best.

Wishlist now on #steam!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3610180?utm_source=jandu&utm_medium=youtube&utm_campaign=revealtrailer
